issue.title: Ctrl-K search: add Conversations to the type list
acceptanceCriteria: The Ctrl-K type list includes Conversations alongside Actions, Workspaces, and Issues.
Selecting Conversations limits results to conversation entries.
The Conversations entry supports the same keyboard navigation, selection, active-state, and clear/reset behavior as existing types.
Empty, loading, and error states are correct when the Conversations type is selected.
Tests cover selecting Conversations, filtering results, clearing the type, and keyboard navigation.
Conversation ordering composes correctly with #3703 and the toggle requested in #3704.

blocker.title: A pinned Conversations scope disappears when it is the only present scope
